verdict.rationale: Greptile automatically reviews every PR [docs-1] and posts a review summary [docs-3]. That summary has a confidence score, a short verdict and a severity-sorted findings list linked to each comment [docs-37], plus an at-a-glance 0-5 merge-safety score [docs-16]. It also generates sequence diagrams and flowcharts for every PR to help reviewers parse complex changes [docs-17, docs-53], which together cover the orientation goal. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a prose description of what the PR changes or a file-by-file change walkthrough (the documented summary is review-centric), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the summary and diagram output.
